notes.title: Patch note 1.0.5
notes.content:
[p]The following has been addressed in this update.

◆ Additions[/p][list][*][p][b]Portuguese (Brazil) Translation[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Mail Screen: Added scroll indicator icon[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Title Screen: Version number displayed[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]◆ Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p][b]Mail Screen: Scrollbar emphasized[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]◆ Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Fixed an issue where results sometimes wouldn't display at the end of business hours.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed an issue where "Downed zombies" text in results was not localized.[/b][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch note 1.0.4
notes.content:
This is an adjustment to make it easier to play.

◆Difficulty adjustment
Made it a little easier to see the glimpses.
Increased the frequency of regular customers who are shown glimpses.
Increased the time allowed for post-service operations.
Slowed down the bee speed a little.

◆Bug Fixes
Fixed shotgun effect.

notes.title: Patch Note 1.0.3
notes.content:
◆Additional Elements
Supported Russian language
Initial language selection according to steam settings

◆Difficulty adjustment
Increased the frequency of being greeted a little.
Reduced the frequency of being robbed a little.

Bug fixes
Fixed the result display.
Fixed a bug of Korean text.
Fixed a design of Korean text.

notes.title: Patch note 1.0.2
notes.content:
◆Additional
12 types of achievements are now supported.
If you have already played the game, you can earn them when you start the game.
※The contents were displayed in advance on the store page. We apologize for that.

◆Difficulty
The amount of money that can be obtained by driving away robbers with a shotgun has been reduced.
The amount of money robbed by the robber has been lowered a little.
The amount of money robbed has been lowered a little.

◆Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug that some functions were disabled after the ending.
